summary: Closes the grader's R-4 gaps on the REAL backend in one run of the maintained driver (scripts/verify-identities-r4.mjs, P015_R4_REAL_RECOVERY=1) inside verify-tauri-headless.sh with an isolated database. Pointer clicks write identityId and identityTab to the URL; a fresh navigation to the captured URL restores the same identity and the Provider bindings tab. That tab names M3 and exposes 0 control(s), 0 enabled. A concurrent writer held the session row lock until the pointer-clicked Apply's compare-and-swap UPDATE was observed waiting on it (wait_event_type Lock), then committed; the route answered HTTP 409 'changed concurrently'. The launch spec, activation and activation-event count were unchanged, the page showed the failure banner with the prior identity, and Apply stayed enabled. The pointer retry succeeded (HTTP 200), and its identities.surface SSE invalidation reached the page (count 1 -> 5) in the same document. Switch applied at generation 1 (revision e4a2b94ab219); rollback applied at generation 2 (revision 78193131d711). Supersedes docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-operational-2026-09-24.json (source-stale after control-anchor.ts 33f6d2eb12, 2026-09-24 12:20Z); this run also supersedes docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-operational-2026-09-23b.json, whose select/review/switch/rollback journey it repeats.
